reviews.review: They added forced arbitration into their EULA with the new update and dlc. Good game, but I refuse to tolerate this sort of EULA BS, so its getting a negative from me now

I had two short runs during the Free Weekend event. Neither was successful, but I had some fun. The game is straightforward - kill enemies, loot treasure, buy upgrades, kill more enemies.

The space is limited and so are the enemies, but I can see why people (including me) keep playing because both looting and shooting feel good.

Every shot feels hurt the enemy well, it’s satisfying to see them get pushed back a bit. The treasure boxes and enemy's gun drops are generous, in the first run I got a nice sniper rifle, in the second run I found an extremely powerful pistol with a large clip that shoots out a big lightning bomb, dealing significant damage to everyone nearby, almost a one-hit-kill glitched weapon. I saved the ammo yet still failed to kill the boss at the end of the area, mostly due to the dash requiring cooldown which is deadly in boss fights without covers.

That said, this game requires multiple tries as it’s the only way to permanently increase your damage, health, shield etc. I don’t like this kind of design but I imagine it’s good for multiplayer, which is what this game is made for.

⭐ Rating: 9/10 – Addictive, polished, and endlessly fun — one of the best roguelite shooters around.
